description: This file is a shell script designed to test the behavior of Git protocol extensions related to session ID advertisement and negotiation in various scenarios. It sets up repositories, runs fetch and push commands with different configurations, and checks for the presence or absence of session ID keys in trace logs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Runs a test case expecting success with a given shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes for cleanup.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the given repository with specified changes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
